description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03 as 26946c500; COORDINATOR-VERIFIED, not independently multi-lane audited — the API was 529-overloaded and subagent audit lanes could not spawn; the deletion's safety was ALREADY independently proven by the fz-go4.18.28.14 audit, and can be re-audited if desired). Deleted the cosmetic members sort in settle_demand_cone (jobs/runtime_demand.rs) + the now-dead executable_need_order helper the sort was the sole user of. The fz-go4.18.28.14 audit PROVED the sort order-irrelevant (Jacobi fixpoint: frozen prev-round snapshot, commutative/associative semilattice join, value-driven dirty set — answer AND round count order-invariant) and that the sorted members Vec is not consumed by the return value (callers iterate the result HashMaps). So per sorting-is-a-barrier the sort decided nothing and fed no output; replaced with a plain graph.facts.keys().collect() + an order-invariance comment. Coordinator verification: full lib 1162/0/24 (1161 + the .18.31 ride-along test), clippy clean; activation dumps on fz_f98_range_map_converges byte-identical across 3 runs (determinism preserved — the dumps never depended on this sort). This also moots the display()-key's latent closure-tie nondeterminism (fz-go4.34) at THIS site.
title: Delete the cosmetic members sort in settle_demand_cone (sorting-is-a-barrier)
